timeline.title: Pythagoras Project - CIS
timeline.summary: Independent training batches: Consumes exact training actions chronologically across a player's orders; Stops earlier actions from being reused by a later training purchase; Keeps Racehorce's 10-train and 21-train batches independent and totaling 31; Preserves entered usage on manual orders without Torn payment event IDs.

timeline.title: Pythagoras Project - CIS
timeline.summary: Live CIS activity: Replaces the blank startup rectangle with a compact bottom-right activity card; Shows real checked startup milestones, progress, and failures above Torn's icon bar; Gives Sync all the same live progress card with scrolling Sync console messages; Keeps freshly checked key-access status visible after the company workspace loads.

timeline.title: Pythagoras Project - CIS
timeline.summary: Event-backed training orders: Uses Torn's real event ID internally so imported payments survive cloud reloads without duplicating; Keeps the original order row and removes surplus copies during history sync; Preserves distinct same-day payments and never removes manual additions that have no event ID…

timeline.title: Pythagoras Project - CIS
timeline.summary: Organized training-order history: Splits active orders, manual entry, and completed orders into clear tabs; Follows every validated Torn payment and training-action history page; Recognizes bounded historical Traine/Tains references while leaving blank messages manual; Updates only affected rows when orders are edited, completed, or deleted.

timeline.title: Pythagoras Project - CIS
timeline.summary: Training ledger reconciliation: Recognizes Torn's "received 10 trains by the director" company-news wording; Reconciles stored training history when payment-log orders are imported; Repairs existing orders even when their payment is skipped as a duplicate; Adds regression coverage for new and existing ledger entries.

timeline.title: Pythagoras Project - CIS
timeline.summary: Reliable launcher, training, and daily records: Restores the minimized launcher when Torn redraws its footer, without resetting saved settings; Auto sponsored/free trains now exclude enabled addiction or inactivity threshold breaches; paid FIFO remains unaffected; Corrects advertising-budget and isolated departure-wage records at the 18:10 TCT boundary…

timeline.title: Pythagoras Project - CIS
timeline.summary: Automatic company workspace handover: Detects Torn account and company changes before loading or syncing, preserves the historical cloud workspace, and opens a pristine workspace for the verified company; Prevents staff, news, stock, wages, ledgers, planners, and company settings from crossing between companies; Requires verified current-director access…

timeline.title: Pythagoras Project - CIS
timeline.summary: More reliable train payments and closing wages: Recognizes train-payment triggers with extra instructions and tolerates a missing exclamation mark in transfer messages without matching unrelated words; Recovers one isolated missing Balance wage day only when the adjacent verified closing days agree…

timeline.title: cRaCked
timeline.summary: cRaCked 2.4.8 — action button rebind recovery — Detects when Torn swaps the visible brute-force button after a suggested character is sent and rebinds the cRaCked action without a page refresh; Also repairs the binding when Torn reuses the same button node but removes cRaCked's display class or action data during reconciliation…

timeline.title: Pythagoras Project - CIS
timeline.summary: Safer sync and forum testimonies: Fixed the Settings Sync center markup so clicking its explanation, group labels, blank space, or Sync console no longer activates Smart sync. Only an actual sync button starts a request; User-started sync actions are serialized across the title bar, Settings, Stock, staff history, and Testimonies controls.…

timeline.title: cRaCked
timeline.summary: cRaCked 2.4.7 — Android Firefox network compatibility — Supports both Tampermonkey HTTP request APIs so dictionary downloads, community sync and uploads work when Android Firefox exposes only the modern GM.xmlHttpRequest interface; Reports a direct grant/install error instead of an undefined-global failure if neither userscript request API is available.

timeline.title: Pythagoras Project - CIS

Filters and sorting reset the visible batch…

timeline.title: Pythagoras Project - CIS
timeline.summary: Restocking costs and smoother loading: Stock counts, sold quantities, warehouse totals, and stock warnings now use consistent thousands separators on every browser locale; Explicit zero stock values no longer fall back to stale alternate field values…

timeline.title: MoDuL's Pit Guru
timeline.summary: Pit Guru v2.3.7 — 2026-08-31 · Userscript update; Changed; Successful Torn key and active Player licence checks are cached locally for up to 24 hours across page refreshes. Each check keeps its own expiry; a fresh key check no longer discards a valid licence result; Check key always requests fresh key and licence checks.…

timeline.title: cRaCked
timeline.summary: cRaCked 2.4.6 — one-second wait and retry recovery — Reduces the suggestion button's maximum wait from six seconds to one. Expiry unlocks the button without sending another guess automatically; Modifier keys, navigation, deletion and keyboard shortcuts no longer create phantom guesses or restart the countdown while a character input has focus…

timeline.title: cRaCked
timeline.summary: cRaCked 2.4.5 — single tooltip and full button wording — Keeps Torn's styled hover tooltip without bringing back the browser's plain duplicate during button refreshes or modifier-key changes; Hover help updates inside the existing tooltip, preserving its arrow and accessibility association…

timeline.title: cRaCked
timeline.summary: cRaCked 2.4.4 — encrypted job controls and Torn button font — Untouched fully encrypted jobs now receive the cRaCked button controls, so their modal and hover information remain available before any brute force. The same fix covers jobs with no guesses remaining; Modal hover text retains the encryption explanation and remaining brute-force workload.…

timeline.title: cRaCked
timeline.summary: cRaCked 2.4.3 — mobile Firefox identity detection — Detects the logged-in player's name and ID from Torn's embedded account data, even when mobile Firefox/Tampermonkey has no visible profile link; This browser-compatible path needs no API key, cookies, or extra permissions. TornPDA retains its API fallback when embedded account data is unavailable…

timeline.title: cRaCked
timeline.summary: cRaCked 2.4.2 — TornPDA identity detection — TornPDA can now verify the current player's name and ID through TornPDA's documented API-key bridge and Torn's basic profile endpoint; The public-credit switch performs the identity check itself and reports actionable API-key errors instead of asking the user to reopen settings…

timeline.title: cRaCked
timeline.summary: cRaCked 2.4.1 — safe one-shot modifier actions — A modifier-click sends at most one suggested character and waits for Torn's verdict before another action can run. Duplicate miss notifications are collapsed instead of consuming the script's whole guess budget on screen…

timeline.title: cRaCked
timeline.summary: Clearer first-time privacy choice: Fresh installations now open Settings automatically on the cracking page; Public Torn-name credit is presented first and clearly marked as optional. Shared cracks remain anonymous unless the player explicitly opts in…

timeline.title: cRaCked
timeline.summary: Failures now always produce one structured console.error containing: Failure stage; Request URL; HTTP status; Dictionary part; IndexedDB key; Underlying error message.

timeline.title: cRaCked
